tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Scan a domain for AI discoverability. Use when evaluating AI crawler access; NOT when assessing general web crawler policies, use crawler_policy_guide.

tools.name: crawler_policy_guide
tools.description: Retrieve AI crawler policy guide. Use when you need to decide whether to allow or block an AI crawler. Do NOT use when you need to check AI readiness (check_ai_readiness).

tools.name: robots_txt_for_ai
tools.description: Generate robots.txt rules for AI policy and scope. Use when needing AI-specific directives; NOT for general web crawlers, use crawler_policy_guide instead.

tools.name: llms_txt_draft
tools.description: Generate an llms.txt file from your business details and key pages. Use when you need a quick, AI-friendly site summary. Avoid if you need a robots.txt file; use robots_txt_for_ai instead.

tools.name: schema_jsonld_sample
tools.description: Generate a JSON-LD snippet for SEO. Use when you need structured data for search engines. Avoid when you need to check AI readiness, use check_ai_readiness instead.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_ai_readiness" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Scan a domain for AI discoverability: which AI crawlers robots.txt blocks or allows (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot...), llms.txt presence, sitemap, schema.org data, meta and Content Signals. Fetches only /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml and the homepage over HTTPS." → after: "Scan a domain for AI discoverability. Use when evaluating AI crawler access; NOT when assessing general web crawler policies, use crawler_policy_guide."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
